title: ESG Beliefs of Large Language Models: Evidence and Impact

bias_targets.methodology: Eliciting LLM beliefs using established survey instruments originally designed for professional and retail investors through role-definition prompting. The study measures LLM responses regarding ESG materiality, return expectations, climate change concerns, and willingness to sacrifice financial returns, comparing them to human baselines. It also empirically evaluates the real-world impact of this bias by analyzing shifts in financial analysts' stock recommendations for high-ESG firms after adopting AI tools.
